body.p: The Search view's Components tab allows you to define folders which contain DITA XML topics containing XML elements with IDs that can be reused. You can insert content references to those reusable ID elements or open their definition location.

dlentry.dd: A sequence of folder paths in which to search for reusable components. The returned number of reusable components is capped at 10k elements. Any change to the path is saved in the local browser storage.
Search for a component's ID or text to filter the components list.

For each component in the list the source file, element ID and contained text is presented. When hovering over a component you can use the available actions to insert a content reference (or a content key reference if there is a DITA key defined for the reusable component's topic) or to open the topic in which the component is defined.
